description: The installments of every live installment plan in one set of books, oldest first, in a date range (default: 30 days ago to 90 days ahead): money coming in (kind INVOICE) and going out (kind BILL). Each row names the invoice or bill (documentId, documentNumber, partyDisplayName), installment n of installmentCount, its date, amount and what is still open, its status (PAID, PARTLY_PAID, UPCOMING, DUE_TODAY or OVERDUE with daysPastDue), how it is collected (CARD_ON_FILE, PAY_LINK, AUTOPAY or MANUAL) and whether the plan is ACTIVE or PAUSED. asOf is the books' today. Use it for questions like "which installments are due this month" or "which clients are behind on their plan". This only reads.

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

from.description: From this installment date, yyyy-MM-dd (default: 30 days ago).

kind.description: INVOICE (money coming in) or BILL (money going out); both when empty.

to.description: To this installment date, yyyy-MM-dd (default: 90 days ahead).

name: upcoming_installments
title: Upcoming installments
